Remote Compose Examples — PNG vs Remote Compose (Camaelon JS + AndroidX Embedded + AndroidX Embedded · androidx.dev + CMP JVM players)

Camaelon JS: 1286 scored · mean mismatch 4.09% · 49 unscored (blank reference)
AndroidX Embedded · vendored Android: 1184 scored · mean mismatch 11.24% · 120 not rendered · 49 unscored (blank reference)
AndroidX Embedded · androidx.dev: 1189 scored · mean mismatch 12.56% · 117 not rendered · 49 unscored (blank reference)
CMP JVM: 1103 scored · mean mismatch 9.25% · 186 not rendered · 49 unscored (blank reference)
1335 Remote Compose preview(s) · pixelmatch threshold 0.1 · theme light

Every preview across every player: the baked capture (the catalog's own offline Robolectric/Skiko render, through AndroidX's embedded RcPlayer unless the preview pins the view-backed lane) next to the same ir/*.rc document as each player renders it. Camaelon JS is the vendored TypeScript RC.RcdPlayer on a <canvas>; AndroidX Embedded · vendored Android is this repo's pinned and locally patched RcPlayer, rasterized by Robolectric; AndroidX Embedded · androidx.dev is the independently compiled player published by the pinned AndroidX snapshot; CMP JVM is rc-player-compose on Compose Desktop / Skiko, rasterizing offscreen — the same player as the Wasm lane, on the JVM (wire id cmp-jvm) — so they diverge wherever those differences show. Nothing is diffed until you ask for it: pick a column in Diff against and every other column grows a pixel diff plus a mismatch chip. Choosing the baked lane replays the build-time pixelmatch diffs; choosing a player diffs in the browser, which is how you compare two players directly. Rows sort worst-match-first on the worst-scoring player using the build-time scores in the header. A preview whose baked render is fully transparent is shown but not scored against it: with nothing in the reference, a player that draws nothing would score a perfect 0% — so those rows read no reference and stay out of the means.

Not in this run: CMP Wasm. A player earns a column only where the run recorded a verdict for it, so these are absent rather than empty — the publishing workflow opts each lane in per catalog.
